Consider the initial value problem
$y^{′} + 5y = f(x), y(0) = 2$
where $f(x)$ is a $2$-periodic function. Fill in the missing part in the solution of the IVP, where the infinite sum on the right-hand side below represents a particular solution $y_{p}$ of the differential equation.

*Hint: In this specific problem, the forcing function $f(x)$ is chosen such that the particular solution $y_{p}$ satisfies $y_{p}(0) = 0$.*

The solution is

$y(x)∼$
{{field-1}}
$+ ∑_(n = 1)^(∞)(a_{n}\cos (nπx) + b_{n}\sin (nπx))$
